description: Current air quality at a place: PM2.5 and PM10 (µg/m³), US and European AQI, from Copernicus CAMS via Open-Meteo, with a signed receipt. Pass latitude and longitude, or a city. Costs $0.001 per call. The first 5 priced calls per caller are free.

city.description: A city instead of coordinates, e.g. "Tokyo"; many spellings work (Токио, 東京).

name: air_quality_now
